HOW_TO_READ: `state` is a claim by the writer. Everything under `observed` is counted from disk by benchmark/synth/render/status.py and is the thing to trust. Poll with `status.py --world W2_DEV_001 --json`: `observed.complete_by_counts` is true only when every selected spec has both an artifact and a verify verdict. A `state` of in_progress with a large `claim_age_minutes` means the writing session probably died -- but check observed.idle_minutes first, because a long render legitimately runs for hours between notes.
